answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The lotus cap is applied at intake and hollow exposes the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a ferrous tag. That is 2 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
